title: Homebuyer Education Goodwill on Rate Lock Commitment Appraisal-Delay Waivers
content:
**Concession terms for educated homebuyers (Rate Lock Commitment).** When Larkspur waives on its own initiative an extension charge that the appraisal-delay case covers, and only in such a waiver, it also bears homebuyer-education goodwill days. These are added to the covered days of the extension. The covered days, these days included, are never below zero and never more than the extension's charged days.

The basis is the **Mortgage Loan File**: whether a homebuyer education certificate is on the file, and the file's qualifying income as a whole-number percentage of the area median income.

**Rule.**

- When a homebuyer education certificate is on the loan file and the file's qualifying income is at or below the moderate-income ceiling of **100** percent of the area median income, the educated moderate-income goodwill of **2** days is added.
- When a certificate is on file and the qualifying income is above that ceiling, the educated goodwill of **1** day is added.
- Otherwise none are added.

| Certificate on the file | Qualifying income (percent of area median income) | Goodwill days |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 100 or below | 2 |
| Yes | 101 or above | 1 |
| No | Any | 0 |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical):* a certified borrower at exactly 100 percent receives 2 days, and at 101 percent receives 1 day. A borrower at 80 percent with no certificate receives none.
